name: component-confidence-cap
description: A library analyzed with no consumer declared and every finding asked for. A published function only a test calls is reported as test-only use at possible, and the test that calls it alone is reported as a test of dead code at possible too, though its own reachability class is certain, because a finding about a member of a dead component carries no higher confidence than the component's root members. An internal function only its test calls, and that test, are reported at certain, and a published function nothing calls is reported at possible while the internal function it calls is not reported.
